name: Node Wiring Test
author: pgianotto
description: Pick an FPP model and step, auto-chase, or camera-scan through its nodes to catch wiring mistakes before a show runs, using FPP's own channel-test API. Can optionally use your device's camera or a USB camera on this FPP box to help spot mismatches; camera frames are processed in memory and never saved to disk.

privacy.summary: Lights one node at a time via FPP's channel-test API. Can watch a camera for mismatches (frames never saved), stream a local USB camera to your browser, or fetch xLights' public vendor model list.

sends.what: live video from the USB camera
sends.why: so another device's browser can view/auto-scan the camera on this device

sends.to: GitHub (raw.githubusercontent.com) and individual lighting-prop vendors' own websites
sends.what: a request for xLights' public vendor model list and, if you pick one, that vendor's own .xmodel file
sends.why: to search xLights' own vendor model catalog (the same list its Download Models dialog uses) and patch a corrected .xmodel into a real commercial model, keeping its faces/states instead of discarding them

systemChanges.what: Opens a local port serving a USB camera's video while you have it running (Start/Stop Camera); not a system service, does not start on boot.

privacy.other: Test-mode channel overrides, the mismatch log and scan results are all transient (in fppd or the browser tab) and are not written to FPP's configuration. The camera feature is off by default and only active while you have it started. The vendor model catalog (public model names/URLs, re-fetched periodically) and any vendor .xmodel files you download through it are cached under the plugin's own data directory for performance, not as a system service.
